issue: Flatulence and pollakiuria are each recorded twice with identical start (2013-10-27) and end (2014-04-04) dates but conflicting outcomes; the 'Not recovered/not resolved' records also carry an end date.
query_text: Two adverse events appear to be recorded twice, with conflicting outcomes. FLATULENCE (AE records 2 and 4) and POLLAKIURIA (AE records 1 and 3) each started on 2013-10-27 and ended on 2014-04-04, and both are recorded as mild, non-serious and not related. In each pair, one record has outcome 'NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED' and the other has 'RECOVERED/RESOLVED'. The 'not recovered' records also have an end date of 2014-04-04, which does not match that outcome. Please confirm whether each pair is a duplicate entry or two separate episodes. Please also confirm the correct outcome and end date for each event, and update or delete records as needed.
